references.text: Moses commands the Israelites to take vengeance on the Midianites, which leads to the destruction of their cities.
The law concerning burning an idolatrous city with fire and leaving it as a permanent ruin.
The Israelites burn Jericho with fire, a parallel to the destruction of the Midianite cities.
Ai is burned with fire after the Israelites capture the city.
Joshua burns Hazor with fire but leaves the other cities on the hills standing.
The tribe of Judah captures Jerusalem and burns the city with fire.
The Israelites burn Benjamin's cities with fire during the civil war.
The Amalekites had burned Ziklag with fire, a similar act of warfare.
